author: Lintuxer
tagline: First start takes 90 seconds — self-hosted invoicing
description:
Invoice Ninja 5 — invoicing, quotes, recurring billing, time tracking and
online payments. MySQL and Redis are part of the same ZimaOS app; PDFs are
rendered by the Chrome that ships inside the app image.

**Install it through "Custom install", not the blue button.** Switch on
"Advanced (show more)", pick the service `app` in the row of tabs and edit
three of its variables:

- `APP_URL` — the address you browse to, including the port. Invoice Ninja
  builds PDF links, mail links and the client portal from it.
- `APP_KEY` — the key in this file is public, because this file is public.
  Generate your own:
  `docker run --rm invoiceninja/invoiceninja-debian php artisan key:generate --show`
- `IN_PASSWORD` — the first administrator's password, together with
  `IN_USER_EMAIL`. The account is created once, on the first start.

**After installing, wait about 90 seconds — longer than ZimaOS waits.**
The app runs its database migrations before it serves anything and
answers `502` until they are done; ZimaOS already says *running* by then.
Once the page comes up, sign in with `IN_USER_EMAIL` and `IN_PASSWORD`.

tips.before_install: Set APP_URL to the address you browse to (including the port), generate your own APP_KEY, and change IN_PASSWORD before the first start. The admin account is created once, on first start.
